spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sideways, awry, irregular.
E.
तिय्यच् and ख aff.

ind.
1 Indirectly, underhandedly, secretly, covertly.
5 Crookedly, awry.
6 A particle of abuse or depreciation.
E.
तॄ to go, असच् aff.

f. (-णी)
1 An outer tent, a Kenāt, a wall or screen of cloth surrounding the principal tent.
2 A veil.
3 A curtain.
E.
तिरस् secret, and करिणी making; also with the antepen. vowel long, तिरस्कारिणी.

m. (-रः)
1 Disrespect, abuse, reproach.
2 Disappearance, concealment.
E.
तिरस् disrespect, and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Reviled, abused, reproached, censured.
2 Veiled, hidden.
3 Vanished, disappeared.
E.
तिरस्, and कृत made.

f. (-या)
1 Disrespect, contempt, reproach.
2 Disappearance, concealment.
E.
तिरस् disrespect, and क्रिया action.

m. (-टः)
The joint of the sugar cane.

m. (-टः)
Pale Lodh, a kind of tree: see लोध्र.
n. (-टं)
A diadem, a tiara.
E.
तॄ to pass, कीटन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-मः)
A kind of rice.

m. (-यः)
A sort of rice.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Disappeared, vanished, out of sight.
E.
तिरस्, and गत gone.

n. (-नं)
1 A cover or concealment, a sheath, a veil, a cloth or cloak, any thing which withholds another from sight.
2 Disappearance, the being hidden or the act of hiding or vanishing.
E.
तिरस् concealing, and धान having or holding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Covered, concealed, hidden, removed or withdrawn from sight.
E.
तिरम् covering, धा to have, affix क्त.

ind.
Crookedly, awry: see तिर्य्यच्.

m. (-ताः)
An animal, a beast or bird.
E.
तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and स्रोतस् motion.

mfn. (-ग्जः-ग्जा-ग्जं)
Born of an animal or insect.
E.
तिर्य्यच्, and ज born.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Of the brute species, born as an animal.
f. (-तिः)
The brute kind.
E.
तिर्य्यच्, and जाति species.

n. (-रं)
A barley corn.
E.
तिर्य्यच् curved, यव barley, उदर the interior.

m. (-नः)
A crab.
E.
तिर्य्यक् crookedly, and यान motion, going.

mfn. (-निः-निः-नि)
Born of or as an animal.
E.
तिर्य्यच्, and योनि place of birth.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of the brute kind.
m. (-यः)
The race or kind of animals, birds, &c.
E.
तिर्य्यग्योनि, and अन्वय race.

तिर्य्यच् or तिर्य्यञ्च्
mfn. (तिर्य्यङ् तिरञ्ची तिर्य्यक्)
Moving tortuously, going crookedly or awry, (the neuter is also used adverbially: see तिर्य्यक्.)
m. (-र्य्यङ्)
1 An animal, a quadruped.
2 A bird, or any animal moving tortuously.
f. (-र्य्यञ्ची)
The female of an animal, a beast or bird.
E.
तिरस् crookedly, अञ्च to go, affix क्विप्.

r. 10th cl. (तीरयति)
To finish or complete, to get through or over.

n. (-रं)
1 A shore, a bank.
2 An arrow.
m. (-रः)
Tin.
f. (-री)
A kind of arrow.
E.
तीर to get through or over, अच् aff.

m. (-क्तिः)
Tirhut, a province in the east of central Hindustan, lying on the north of Behar.
E.
तीर a bank, and भुक्ति here signifying a limit: being bounded on the west and east by the Gandaki and Kauśikī rivers, on the south by the Ganges, and on the north, by the skirts of the Himāla mountains.

m. (-टः)
Lodh: see तिरीट.

n. (-रं)
The opposite bank or shore.
E.
तीर, and अन्तर beyond.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Adjudged, settled, finished.
n. (-तं)
1 Completion of any act or affair.
2 Corrupt or improper non-infliction of a sentence.
E.
तीर to get through, affix क्त.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Crossed, passed over.
2 Spread, expanded.
3 Surpassed, excelled.
E.
तॄ to pass, affix क्त.

f. (-दी)
A plant: see तालमूली.
E.
तीर्ण spreading, and पाद foot or root.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Crossed, having crossed.
E.
त to cross, affix क्तवतु.

mn. (-र्थः-र्थं)
1 Sacred science, or any of the branches of knowledge esteemed holy.
2 A holy place, any place of pilgrimage, as Benares, &c. but especially particular spots along the course of sacred streams, as the Ganges, &c. and in the vicinity of some piece of water or sacred springs.
3 Any piece of water.
4 A Ghāt or stairs of a landing place.
5 A sacred preceptor, a

Guru.
6

Sacrifice.
7

An Avatāra or descent of a deity.
8 A school of philosophy, a Darśana, a sect.
9 A counsellor, an adviser.
10 An expedient, a means of success.
11 The menses.
12 Pudendum muliebre.
13 A vessel.
14 A royal vessel.
15 A

Brahman.
16

Ascertainment of disease.
17

Fire.
18

A part of the hand sacred to any [] deity, as between the thumb and finger to the manes, the root of the thumb to BRAHMA, &c.
E.
तॄ to pass over, थक् Uṇādi affix; by which persons are extricated from sin, difficulty, &c.

m. (-रः)
One of the synonyms of a Jina or sanctified teacher of the Jaina sect.
E.
तीर्थ pure, purity, and कर who does or acts; also retaining the nasal तीर्थङ्कर.

m. (-कृत्)
A Jina: see the preceding.

m. (-ङ्क्षः)
An epithet of contempt, a crow, as it were, at a pilgrimage.
E.
तीर्थ, and ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow.

f. (-जी)
A name of Benāres.
E.
तीर्थ a holy place, and राजी the queen: the most eminent of the Tīrthas or places of pilgrimage.

m. (-कः)
A curl of hair.
E.
तीर्थ, and वच to speak, affix घञ्.

mf. (-वी-विनी)
1 A pilgrim.
2 A sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.)
E.
तीर्थ, and सेविन् who frequents.
